text: ādittasuttaṃ [135] evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme . atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi . [136] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi ādittasmiṃ agārasmiṃ yaṃ nīharati bhājanaṃ taṃ tassa hoti atthāya no ca yaṃ tattha ḍayhati evamādittako loko 1 jarāya maraṇena ca nīharetheva dānena dinnaṃ hoti sunibbhataṃ dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti nādinnaṃ hoti taṃ tathā corā haranti rājāno aggi ḍayhati nassati #1 sī. yu. evamādīpito loko . evamādittake loketipi pāṭhena pana bhavitabbaṃ . atha antena jahati sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ etadaññāya medhāvī bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca datvā ca 1 bhutvā ca yathānubhāvaṃ anindito saggamupeti ṭhānanti . dutiyaṃ
